record.name: Trooper
record.description: Troupers are elite military specialists trained in heavy weapons, tactical warfare, and battlefield control. They excel at suppressing enemy positions, providing covering fire, and coordinating with their squadmates to achieve tactical objectives.

progression_tree.description: You are proficient with heavy weapons and can use them without disadvantage. Additionally, you can carry heavy weapons without suffering movement penalties.

effects.notes: Proficient with heavy weapons without disadvantage
No movement penalty for carrying heavy weapons

progression_tree.description: Choose your approach to military tactics.
Focus on heavy weapons and firepower.
Focus on tactical coordination and battlefield control.
Choose your specialization as a Trooper.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.
You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
You gain a feature from your chosen specialization.
You can use your bonus action to grant advantage on the next attack roll made by an ally within 30 feet of you before the end of your next turn.

effects.notes: Grant advantage to ally's next attack

progression_tree.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.
You gain a feature from your chosen specialization.
When an ally within 30 feet of you is targeted by an attack, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

effects.notes: Impose disadvantage on attack against ally

progression_tree.description: You gain a feature from your chosen specialization.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.
You gain a feature from your chosen specialization.
You can use your action to grant all allies within 30 feet of you advantage on their next attack roll before the end of your next turn.

effects.notes: Grant advantage to all allies' next attacks

progression_tree.description: You gain a feature from your chosen specialization.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.
You gain a feature from your chosen specialization.
You can use your action to create a zone of control. Choose a 20-foot radius sphere centered on yourself. Enemies in this area have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you.

effects.notes: Disadvantage on attacks against others in zone

progression_tree.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.

You have mastered the art of tactical warfare. You can use your action to enter a state of tactical focus. For 1 minute, you have advantage on all attack rolls, and your allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on their attack rolls.

effects.notes: Advantage on all attack rolls during tactical focus
Allies have advantage on attack rolls during tactical focus

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Bulky stance, heavy blasters at the ready, tactical eyes scanning for threats
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Glows with a faint blue light, signifying technological prowess and coordination

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Elite military specialist in a firefight

progression_path.emergence: The Trooper's military prowess is seen as a threat to those who value cunning over brute force.
progression_path.escalation: As the Trooper gains recognition for their tactical victories, they begin to attract the attention of rival soldiers seeking to outdo them.
progression_path.confrontation: A direct challenge from a rival soldier forces the Trooper to defend their reputation and tactics in a high-stakes showdown.

resolution_paths.victory: The Trooper emerges victorious, solidifying their position as a top-tier military specialist and earning respect from their peers.
resolution_paths.redemption: Despite initial setbacks, the Trooper adapts their tactics and wins over their rival through strategic alliances and mutual respect.
resolution_paths.escape: The Trooper narrowly escapes the confrontation, vowing to return stronger and more determined than ever to prove themselves in battle.

conflict_triggers: Unorthodox tactics that disregard established military protocols
Inconsistent team coordination and communication skills
Overemphasis on individual success at the expense of squadmate well-being

romance_progression.stage1: The Trooper's rugged, no-nonsense demeanor hides a romantic interest in the player character. A subtle flirting exchange hints at deeper feelings.
romance_progression.stage2: As trust builds between the Trooper and the player character, they begin to open up about their personal life, revealing vulnerabilities and fears.
romance_progression.stage3: The Trooper invites the player character to join them on a mission, providing an opportunity for shared experiences and growth in their relationship.
romance_progression.stage4: Confronting a traumatic event from their past, the Trooper turns to the player character for support and comfort, strengthening their emotional bond.
romance_progression.stage5: With their relationship at its peak, the Trooper must navigate the complexities of military life while nurturing their love for the player character amidst the chaos of battle.

lifestyle_challenges: High-stress environments that test patience and understanding in relationships
Duty-bound priorities often conflicting with romantic interests

record.flavor_text: A loyal protector of the galaxy, Troopers stand unwavering on the battlefield.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: The Trooper class excels at suppressing enemy positions and providing covering fire. When interacting with players, emphasize the importance of teamwork and coordination to achieve tactical objectives.
narrative_hooks: As a seasoned soldier, you've seen your fair share of battles.
Your comms device crackles to life, briefing you on the mission's parameters.
A blaster bolt whizzes past your ear, snapping you back into focus.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Troopers are known for their discipline and loyalty. Players can expect a strong sense of camaraderie with their fellow troopers, but beware of strict adherence to protocol.

personality.behavior: Cautious, but willing to take calculated risks

tactics: Suppress enemy positions with heavy fire
Provide covering fire for fellow soldiers
combat_behavior.strategy: Coordinate with squadmates to achieve tactical objectives

social_patterns: Maintain a professional demeanor at all times
personal_connections: Form strong bonds with fellow troopers

trust_levels: Eroded by repeated questioning of authority

services: Provide tactical support and guidance to players
Offer expertise on military protocols and procedures
Coordinate with other NPCs to provide comprehensive support
